newsitem.title: USA: Zycon Q4 Malaysia loss may rise to $1.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Zycon Q4 Malaysia loss may rise to $1.2 mln.

text.p: Zycon Corp said Monday it estimated its loss from its Malaysia in the range of $1.0 million to $1.2 million in the fourth quarter.
That loss will drag earnings per share lower by between $0.09 and $0.11 a share based on about 11.1 million shares outstanding, the company said in a statement.
The company said the loss, which will not be tax-deductible, was caused by the limited sales level from the Malaysia facility combined with its large fixed overhead base.
The Malaysia plant is expected to begin generating monthly operating profits by the end of 1997, Zycon said.
Earlier Zycon reported third quarter earnings per share of $0.17 compared with pro forma earnings of $0.27 for the year-ago period.
